name: Livermore Area Youth Advisory Commission (LAYAC)
what_you_do: Youth members advise the City Council and the Livermore recreation district on what young people need. They also organize events that promote respect for diversity among Livermore youth.
who_can_apply: Youths ages 12 through 20, preferably attending Livermore schools. Youth members who attend Livermore schools do not have to live in the city (Livermore Municipal Code 2.51.010).
pay_detail: Advisory commission seat. No pay is stated in the code.
deadline_text: Application dates not found. The city teen page that would list them returned an access block to our reads.
how_to_apply: Not confirmed. Contact the City of Livermore to ask how to apply and when the next seats open.
notes: Confirm first. The membership and duties come from Livermore Municipal Code Chapter 2.51, read on the code publisher's page. The city's own teen page (livermoreca.gov) returned HTTP 403 to both our fetch tools, so the application process, term, and dates are not confirmed. The municipal code gives 15 youth seats and 3 adult seats; the code does not say how seats are filled.
